1.en: The Reality the Resurrection in which is realised the truth of all that was rejected in the way of the raising from the graves the reckoning and the requital or it means the Resurrection which will manifest all of that.
1.ar:
سُورَة الحاقَّة [ مَكِّيَّة وآياتها اثْنَتانِ وخَمْسُونَ آيَة ]

﴿الحاقَّة﴾ القِيامَة الَّتِي يَحِقّ فِيها ما أُنْكِرَ مِن البَعْث والحِساب والجَزاء أوْ المُظْهِرَة لِذَلِكَ

2.en: What is the Reality? ma’l-hāqqa an interrogative to emphasise its enormity; this is the subject as well as the predicate of the previous al-hāqqa ‘the Reality’.
2.ar: ﴿ما الحاقَّة﴾ تَعْظِيم لِشَأْنِها وهُوَ مُبْتَدَأ وخَبَر الحاقَّة

3.en: And how would you know what the Reality is? repeated as an extra emphasis of its enormity; the first mā of the previous verse is the subject the second one its predicate; the second mā and its predicate also function as the second direct object of the verb ‘knowing’.
3.ar: ﴿وما أدْراك﴾ أعْلَمَك ﴿ما الحاقَّة﴾ زِيادَة تَعْظِيم لِشَأْنِها فَما الأُولى مُبْتَدَأ وما بَعْدها خَبَره وما الثّانِيَة وخَبَرها فِي مَحَلّ المَفْعُول الثّانِي لِأَدْرى

4.en: Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Clatterer the Resurrection because its terrors cause the hearts to clatter.
4.ar: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُود وعاد بِالقارِعَةِ﴾ القِيامَة لِأَنَّها تَقْرَع القُلُوب بِأَهْوالِها

5.en: As for Thamūd they were destroyed by the overwhelming Roar an excessively severe cry.
5.ar: ﴿فَأَمّا ثَمُود فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطّاغِيَةِ﴾ بِالصَّيْحَةِ المُجاوِزَة لِلْحَدِّ فِي الشِّدَّة

6.en: And as for ‘Ād they were destroyed by a deafening intensely clamorous violent wind that was powerful and severe in its assault upon ‘Ād despite their power and might.
6.ar: ﴿وأَمّا عاد فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَر عاتِيَة﴾ قَوِيَّة شَدِيدَة عَلى عادٍ مَعَ قُوَّتهمْ وشِدَّتهمْ

7.en: He forced it upon them for seven nights and eight days the first of which was the morning of Wednesday eight days before the end of the month of Shawwāl and this was at the height of winter successively one after the next husūman it the action of the wind is likened to the repeated actions of a hāsim ‘one cauterizing a wound’ time and again until it the blood has been cut off inhsama so that you might have seen the people therein lying prostrate lying dead on the ground as if they were the hollow collapsed trunks of palm-trees.
7.ar: ﴿سَخَّرَها﴾ أرْسَلَها بِالقَهْرِ ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْع لَيالٍ وثَمانِيَة أيّام﴾ أوَّلها مِن صُبْح يَوْم الأَرْبِعاء لِثَمانٍ بَقِينَ مِن شَوّال وكانَتْ فِي عَجُز الشِّتاء ﴿حُسُومًا﴾ مُتَتابِعات شُبِّهَتْ بِتَتابُعِ فِعْل الحاسِم فِي إعادَة الكَيّ عَلى الدّاء كَرَّة بَعْد أُخْرى حَتّى يَنْحَسِم ﴿فَتَرى القَوْم فِيها صَرْعى﴾ مَطْرُوحِينَ هالِكِينَ ﴿كَأَنَّهُمْ أعْجاز﴾ أُصُول ﴿نَخْل خاوِيَة﴾ ساقِطَة فارِغَة

8.en: So do you see any remnant of them? min bāqiyatin this is either the adjectival qualification of an implicit nafs ‘soul’ or the final suffixed tā’ is for hyperbole in other words understand it as fa-hal tarā lahum min bāqin ‘any one remaining?’ No!.
8.ar: ﴿فَهَلْ تَرى لَهُمْ مِن باقِيَة﴾ لا تَرى لَهُمْ باقِيَة

9.en: And Pharaoh and those of his followers man qibalahu a variant reading has man qablahu that is to say those disbelieving communities who came before him and the Deviant cities that is their inhabitants — these being the cities of the people of Lot — brought iniquity they committed deeds that were iniquitous.
9.ar: ﴿وجاءَ فِرْعَوْن ومَن قَبَله﴾ أتْباعه وفِي قِراءَة بِفَتْحِ القاف وسُكُون الباء أيْ مَن تَقَدَّمَهُ مِن الأُمَم الكافِرَة ﴿والمُؤْتَفِكات﴾ أيْ أهْلها وهِيَ قُرى قَوْم لُوط ﴿بِالخاطِئَةِ﴾ بِالفِعْلاتِ ذات الخَطَأ

10.en: Then they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord namely Lot and others so He seized them with a devastating blow one surpassing others in its severity.
10.ar: ﴿فَعَصَوْا رَسُول رَبّهمْ﴾ أيْ لُوطًا وغَيْره ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمْ أخْذَة رابِيَة﴾ زائِدَة فِي الشِّدَّة عَلى غَيْرها

11.en: Truly when the waters rose high when they rose above all things including mountains and otherwise at the time of the Flood We carried you meaning your forefathers you being in their loins in the sailing vessel the ark which Noah built and by which he and those with him were saved while all the others drowned
11.ar: ﴿إنّا لَمّا طَغى الماء﴾ عَلا فَوْق كُلّ شَيْء مِن الجِبال وغَيْرها زَمَن الطُّوفان ﴿حَمَلْناكُمْ﴾ يَعْنِي آباءَكُمْ إذْ أنْتُمْ فِي أصْلابهمْ ﴿فِي الجارِيَة﴾ السَّفِينَة الَّتِي عَمِلَها نُوح ونَجا هُوَ ومَن كانَ مَعَهُ فِيها وغَرِقَ الآخَرُونَ

12.en: so that We might make it namely this act the saving of the believers and the destruction of the disbelievers a reminder a lesson for you and that receptive ears ears which remember what they hear might remember it.
12.ar: ﴿لِنَجْعَلها﴾ أيْ هَذِهِ الفَعْلَة وهِيَ إنْجاء المُؤْمِنِينَ وإهْلاك الكافِرِينَ ﴿لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَة﴾ عِظَة ﴿وتَعِيها﴾ ولِتَحْفَظها ﴿أُذُن واعِيَة﴾ حافِظَة لِما تَسْمَع

13.en: Thus when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast to announce the passing of judgement upon all creatures — this being the second blast —
13.ar: ﴿فَإذا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّور نَفْخَة واحِدَة﴾ لِلْفَصْلِ بَيْن الخَلائِق وهِيَ الثّانِيَة

14.en: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single levelling

15.en: then on that day the imminent Event will come to pass the Resurrection will take place

16.en: and the heaven will be rent asunder — for it will be very frail on that day —

17.en: and the angels will be all over its borders the edges of the heavens and above them — the angels that have been mentioned — on that day eight angels or eight files of them will carry the Throne of your Lord.
17.ar: ﴿والمَلَك﴾ يَعْنِي: المَلائِكَة ﴿عَلى أرْجائِها﴾ جَوانِب السَّماء ﴿ويَحْمِل عَرْش رَبّك فَوْقهمْ﴾ أيْ المَلائِكَة المَذْكُورِينَ ﴿يَوْمئِذٍ ثَمانِيَة﴾ مِن المَلائِكَة أوْ مِن صُفُوفهمْ

18.en: On that day you will be exposed before the Reckoning. No hidden thing of yours in the way of secrets will remain hidden read feminine person takhfā or masculine person yakhfā.
18.ar: ﴿يَوْمئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ﴾ لِلْحِسابِ ﴿لا تَخْفى﴾ بِالتّاءِ والياء ﴿مِنكُمْ خافِيَة﴾ مِن السَّرائِر

19.en: As for him who is given his book in his right hand he will say addressing those around him on account of the joy that has come to him ‘Here take and read my book! kitābiyah both hā’ūmu ‘here is’ and iqra’ū ‘read’ compete for government of this direct object.
19.ar: ﴿فَأَمّا مَن أُوتِيَ كِتابه بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُول﴾ خِطابًا لِجَماعَتِهِ لِما سُرَّ بِهِ ﴿هاؤُمُ﴾ خُذُوا ﴿اقْرَءُوا كِتابِي﴾ تَنازَعَ فِيهِ هاؤُمُ واقْرَءُوا

20.en: I was truly certain that I would encounter my account’.

21.en: So he will enjoy a pleasant living

23.en: whose clusters whose fruits are in easy reach nearby reached easily by one who may be standing or sitting or reclining.
23.ar: ﴿قُطُوفها﴾ ثِمارها ﴿دانِيَة﴾ قَرِيبَة يَتَناوَلها القائِم والقاعِد والمُضْطَجِع

24.en: And so it will be said to them ‘Eat and drink in enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier that is to say mutahanni’īna ‘while you are enjoying them’ for what you did in advance in former days’ in days that have passed during the life of the world.
24.ar: فَيُقال لَهُمْ ﴿كُلُوا واشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا﴾ حال أيْ مُتَهَنِّئِينَ ﴿بِما أسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الأَيّام الخالِيَة﴾ الماضِيَة فِي الدُّنْيا

25.en: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand he will say ‘O yā is for calling attention to something would that I had not been given my book
25.ar: ﴿وأَمّا مَن أُوتِيَ كِتابه بِشِمالِهِ فَيَقُول يا﴾ لِلتَّنْبِيهِ

26.en: and not known what my account were!

27.en: O would that it namely death in the life of this world had been the final end that had terminated my life so that I am not resurrected.
27.ar: ﴿يا لَيْتَها﴾ أيْ المَوْتَة فِي الدُّنْيا ﴿كانَتْ القاضِيَهْ﴾ القاطِعَة لِحَياتِي بِأَنْ لا أُبْعَث

28.en: My wealth has not availed me.

29.en: My authority my strength my argument has gone from me’ the final hā’ in kitābiyah ‘my book’ hisābiyah ‘my account’ and sultāniyah ‘my authority’ is for consonantal quiescence; and it is retained when reciting with a pause as well as without a pause in accordance with the authoritative version of the Qur’ānic text and the transmitted reports; some elide it when reciting without a pause.
29.ar: ﴿هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطانِيَهْ﴾ قُوَّتِي وحُجَّتِي وهاء كِتابِيَهْ وحِسابِيَهْ ومالِيَهْ وسُلْطانِيَهْ لِلسَّكْتِ تَثْبُت وقْفًا ووَصْلًا اتِّباعًا لِلْمُصْحَفِ الإمام والنَّقْل ومِنهُمْ مَن حَذَفَها وصْلًا

30.en: ‘Seize him — addressing the keepers of Hell — then fetter him bind his hands to his necks in fetters
30.ar: ﴿خُذُوهُ﴾ خِطاب لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّم ﴿فَغُلُّوهُ﴾ اجْمَعُوا يَدَيْهِ إلى عُنُقه فِي الغُلّ

31.en: then admit him into Hell-fire into the scorching Fire

32.en: then in a chain whose length is seventy cubits — each cubit being that of an angel’s forearm — insert him after admitting him into the Fire the fā’ of fa’slukūhu does not prevent the verb from being semantically connected to the preceding adverbial clause.
32.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ فِي سَلْسَلَة ذَرْعها سَبْعُونَ ذِراعًا﴾ بِذِراعِ المَلَك ﴿فاسْلُكُوهُ﴾ أدْخِلُوهُ فِيها بَعْد إدْخاله النّار ولَمْ تَمْنَع الفاء مِن تَعَلُّق الفِعْل بِالظَّرْفِ المُتَقَدِّم

33.en: Lo! he never believed in God the Tremendous

34.en: and never urged the feeding of the needy;

35.en: therefore here today he has no loyal friend no relative to avail him
35.ar: ﴿فَلَيْسَ لَهُ اليَوْم هاهُنا حَمِيم﴾ قَرِيب يَنْتَفِع بِهِ

36.en: nor any food except pus the vile excretions of the inhabitants of the Fire — or it ghislīn may denote certain trees therein —
36.ar: ﴿ولا طَعام إلّا مِن غِسْلِين﴾ صَدِيد أهْل النّار أوْ شَجَر فِيها

37.en: which none shall eat but the sinners’ the disbelievers.

38.en: So indeed fa-lā lā is extra I swear by all that you see of creatures

39.en: and all that you do not see of them in other words I swear by all creatures
39.ar: ﴿وما لا تُبْصِرُونَ﴾ مِنها أيْ بِكُلِّ مَخْلُوق

40.en: it that is to say the Qur’ān is indeed the speech of a noble messenger in other words he has spoken it as a message from God exalted be He.
40.ar: ﴿إنّهُ﴾ أيْ القُرْآن ﴿لَقَوْل رَسُول كَرِيم﴾ أيْ قالَهُ رِسالَة عَنْ اللَّه تَعالى

41.en: And it is not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!

42.en: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you remember! read both verbs either in the second person plural or in the third person plural; the mā preceding both verbs is extra intended for emphasis. The meaning is they believed and remembered only very few things of what the Prophet s did things such as his good acts his kindness to kin and abstinence; yet this will be of no avail to them.
42.ar: ﴿ولا بِقَوْلِ كاهِن قَلِيلًا ما تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ بِالتّاءِ والياء فِي الفِعْلَيْنِ وما مَزِيدَة مُؤَكَّدَة والمَعْنى أنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا بِأَشْياء يَسِيرَة وتَذْكُرُوها مِمّا أتى بِهِ النَّبِيّ ﷺ مِن الخَيْر والصِّلَة والعَفاف فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئًا

43.en: Rather it is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

44.en: And had he namely the Prophet s fabricated any lies against Us by communicating from Us that which We have not said
44.ar: ﴿ولَوْ تَقَوَّلَ﴾ أيْ النَّبِيّ ﴿عَلَيْنا بَعْض الأَقاوِيل﴾ بِأَنْ قالَ عَنّا ما لَمْ نَقُلْهُ

45.en: We would have assuredly seized him We would have exacted vengeance against him as punishment by the Right Hand by Our strength and power;

46.en: then We would have assuredly severed his life-artery the aorta of the heart a vein that connects with it and which if severed results in that person’s death
46.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنا مِنهُ الوَتِين﴾ نِياط القَلْب وهُوَ عِرْق مُتَّصِل بِهِ إذا انْقَطَعَ ماتَ صاحِبه

47.en: and not one of you ahadin is the subject of mā min being extra used to emphasise the negation; minkum is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ahadin could have defended him hājizīna is the predicate of the preceding mā and it is used in the plural because ahad when employed in a negatory context denotes a plural sense; the suffixed pronoun in ‘anhu refers to the Prophet in other words there is none to prevent Us from punishing him.
47.ar: ﴿فَما مِنكُمْ مِن أحَد﴾ هُوَ اسْم ما ومِن زائِدَة لِتَأْكِيدِ النَّفْي ومِنكُمْ حال مِن أحَد ﴿عَنْهُ حاجِزِينَ﴾ مانِعِينَ خَبَر ما وجُمِعَ لِأَنَّ أحَدًا فِي سِياق النَّفْي بِمَعْنى الجَمْع وضَمِير عَنْهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ أيْ لا مانِع لَنا عَنْهُ مِن حَيْثُ العِقاب

48.en: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a reminder for the God-fearing.

49.en: And assuredly We know that some of you O people are deniers of the Qur’ān and some of you are believers in it.
49.ar: ﴿وإنّا لَنَعْلَم أنَّ مِنكُمْ﴾ أيّها النّاس ﴿مُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ بِالقُرْآنِ ومُصَدِّقِينَ

50.en: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a cause of anguish for the disbelievers when they see the reward of those who affirmed its truth and the punishment of those who denied it.
50.ar: ﴿وإنَّهُ﴾ أيْ القُرْآن ﴿لَحَسْرَة عَلى الكافِرِينَ﴾ إذا رَأَوْا ثَواب المُصَدِّقِينَ وعِقاب المُكَذِّبِينَ بِهِ

51.en: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is the certain truth.
51.ar: ﴿وإنَّهُ﴾ أيْ القُرْآن ﴿لَحَقّ اليَقِين﴾ أيْ اليَقِين الحَقّ

52.en: So glorify exalt as transcendent the Name bi’smi the bā’ bi- is extra of your Lord the Tremendous glory be to Him.
